**Type:** organization

## Description

This was a military hospital founded in 1856. Its first governor was CMY’s friend Colonel [Richard Wilbraham](../people/person_1515.qmd).  It survived until 1978 and is now a country park.





See http://www3.hants.gov.uk/hampshire-countryside/rvcp/history-rvcp.htm 


and  Anne Summers, ['Ministering angels'](../other_books/otherbook_580.qmd).
